name: Taiwan TEA Corp
summary: Taiwan Tea Corporation, established in 1899 and headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan, primarily focuses on the tea industry within the country. Its operations span the entire tea production process, from planting and cultivating tea leaves to manufacturing and distributing its finished tea products. Beyond its core tea business, the company also ventures into developing land for recreational tea farming and manages various marketing channels. Furthermore, it operates a significant construction engineering division, which handles a broad spectrum of projects. These include interior design and decoration, creating partition systems, ceiling installations, anti-smoke vertical barriers, painting, flooring, windowsill finishes, curtain box structures, and stonework, among others. The company's present name was adopted in 1950, changing from its original designation as Mitsui & Co., Ltd.
